newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT -JGBs seen easier after three-day weekend.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -JGBs seen easier after three-day weekend.

text.p: Key June 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures are likely to ease on Tuesday as Tokyo stocks are expected to rise toward the 20,000 level after the three-day holiday weekend.
The Tokyo market was closed on Monday for a holiday.
June's topside is seen capped as a recovery from the recent low of 124.69 may be hampered by rises in stocks.

"We had expected the (June) contract to continue its upside move from last week, but sharp rises in the Nikkei stock average (futures) overseas made that scenario unlikely," said a dealer at a city bank's securities unit.
CME Nikkei 225 stock average futures rose on Monday, with the benchmark June contract ending at 19,890, up 200.
"If the (cash) Nikkei index hits 20,000, June (JGBs) may slip below 125.00," the dealer said.
Traders said, however, that support points lie at 125.15, followed by 125.00.
"I think many operators are still in a holiday mood. That means the contract is highly likely to stay within the recent boxed range," said a securities house dealer.
Some said if the June manages to rise above 125.70 despite stock rises, it may continue its momentum toward 126.00.
